id.description: Exception list item's identifier. Either `id` or `item_id` must be specified.

item_id.description: Human readable exception item string identifier, e.g. `trusted-linux-processes`. Either `id` or `item_id` must be specified.

namespace_type.description:
`single` fetches the item in the current space; `agnostic` fetches a global (space-agnostic) item. Must
match how the list was created.
